```{r}
stringr::str_detect(c("bakeee", "wake", "bik", "bk"), "b.k.")
```

```{r}
stringr::str_detect(c("ds", "ssss", "ddddm", "sddddd"), "d?s+")
```

```{r}
stringr::str_detect(c("maci", "mayi", "mai", "macyi"), "ma[cy]?i")
```


```{r}
stringr::str_detect(c("macai", "mayi", "mai", "macayi"), "ma(ca|y)?i")
```


```{r}

```


```{r}

```
